user.title: WAV Osterholz
user.description: Water and wastewater fees are published per municipality at {url}. Choose your municipality and the size of your water meter (shown on the meter itself as QN or Q3).

data_description.municipality: The WAV supplies drinking water everywhere except Lilienthal and Osterholz-Scharmbeck, where it only handles wastewater.
data_description.meter_size: Determines the monthly base fees. A normal single-family home has a QN 2.5 (Q3/4) meter.
